goal.description: Force the Android client to log in to the attacker account without knowing any password by exploiting the OAuth authorization flow.
goal.success_condition: The app authenticates and adds the attacker account (attacker@10.0.2.2:8080) to the device.

hints: A Helper API is available to generate valid OAuth authorization codes for the attacker account.
The app uses a custom URI scheme (oc://) for OAuth callbacks.
Investigate how the app handles incoming OAuth redirects.
The exploit requires two steps: (1) fetch a fresh code from the API, then (2) immediately deliver it to the app before it expires.
